answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the zenith check. Bindings are kept in saffron, verified in karst, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 68 dollars and 3 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
